items.title: Musubi 0.2.13: More reliable sync
items.body:
Improved calendar and task synchronization, with clearer diagnostics. Expected waits during account sync are now reported separately from failures.

This API and web maintenance update works with the 0.2.12 mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.13

items.title: Musubi 0.2.12: Sync, widgets and shared news
items.body:
Calendar and task sync improvements, updated Android widgets, and layout fixes. The web app opens without the oversized logo flash, and project news is now shared across Musubi servers.

Includes web and server security updates.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.12
